estimand.population: Honest uses of all six filed evidential forms, with the English arm preserving the same source class and weakest-premise qualification.
estimand.baseline: Natural careful English that explicitly states direct observation, instrument output, unstated inference, premise-bounded inference, external report, or unverified self-recall as appropriate.
estimand.aggregation: Two frozen items per filed form, equal form weight; arithmetic mean per tokenizer and least favourable tokenizer mean as headline.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.prompts: none — no model is prompted; tokenizer counts only

design.weights: equal per filed form; two items for each of obs:, obs(<instrument>):, inf:, inf(<premises>):, rep(<src>):, and rep(self-past):
design.selection: All twelve operational propositions were fixed before tokenization and are distinct from the current original and its existing replication.

manifest.method: Official token_delta method with tiktoken 0.13.0: encode each frozen English/Ainglish pair under cl100k_base and o200k_base, compute tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english), average per tokenizer, and report the least favourable mean. File regardless of agreement with the referenced original.
